title: Use Claude to Build a $16K Ebook Business
one_liner: A 4-step system using Claude AI to create and sell digital products on Instagram for passive income.
key_points: Pick an evergreen niche (money, luxury, motivation, relationships, entertainment) that always gets views
Use Claude's 'Digital Product Builder Prompt' to generate a full ebook, PDF guide, or course in 10 minutes
Build a faceless Instagram page around the product with a brandable name, clean bio, and single niche
Create content fast using Claude for scripts, Pexels for visuals, Opus for clips, and Edits for subtitles
